performance.method: Identical Release flags and seven byte-identical harness/support sources. One warm-up plus five alternating measured runs, two sets, with no concurrent local tests or analyzers.
performance.timing_caveat: Small-export medians increased approximately42–49% in these two sets. Allocations, allocated bytes, and measured output/metadata work matched. Other timings were mixed; no general speedup or causal timing claim is made.

restricted_attempt_note: Local-server binding was denied by the execution sandbox. The interrupted capture is retained; the fresh unrestricted capture records the complete passing required run.

limitations: Local LLVM23.1.3 reports the same150 Clang-Tidy findings and one core.DivideZero analyzer finding as fetched main. Their actual nonzero outcomes remain observations; no check or baseline assertion was weakened.
Native PPC/Tiger compiler, SDK and runtime are unavailable. Host cross-selection build/link/runtime success is not native Tiger verification.
The blocking-TTY cancellation limitation and best-effort emergency delivery remain. Partial duplicates and conservative separators are accepted.
Native metadata reservations do not serialize complete concurrent byte streams; actual injected I/O and rdbuf replacement remain caller-synchronized.
